## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run build` passes (from `app/`)
- [ ] `npx tsc --noEmit` is clean
- [ ] Styled with the design tokens (`var(--color-…)`) — no raw hex/`zinc-*` in pages
- [ ] No personal data, real databases, secrets, or API keys committed
- [ ] Empty states are honest (no mocked/fake data)
- [ ] For a connector: added to the registry + a fixture/parse check
